Welcome to DHSK Commerce College
The clear vision, enormous zeal and untiring efforts of the prominent intellectuals and citizens of the region and able guidance by the eminent educationists like late Dr. L. P. Dutt and late Dr. N.K. Basu resulted in the birth of Dibrugarh Hanumanbux Surajmal Kanoi (D.H.S.K.) Commerce College, the first full-fledged Commerce College in the North Eastern Region of India. The importance of introducing commerce education in Dibrugarh was felt by the visionaries of the town way back in the mid-twentieth century. To give shape to their vision, commerce classes at the intermediate level was first introduced in D.H.S.K. College in 1945 in the evening shift. The necessity of having a full-fledged commerce college was realised very soon by the students, academicians as well as the public in general which led to the establishment of D.H.S.K. Commerce College in 1960. The foundation stone of the present college building was laid by Late Morarji Desai, the then Finance Minister of India. Dibrugarh University came into being and also started functioning from this newly constructed college building till 1968.

Dear Students, Parents, and Esteemed Visitors,

College Motto
Vision
''The vision of D.H.S.K. Commerce College is to emerge as a premier educational institution in the region, promoting holistic development through academics and co-curricular activities, while imparting value based education aligned with changing societal needs''
Mission
To achieve this Vision, D.H.S.K. Commerce College has the following missions:
1. To deliver quality commerce education that builds a strong foundation of knowledge and prepares students for evolving career opportunities and societal needs.
2. To support the holistic development of students through academics and co-curricular activities that foster creativity, leadership, and practical life skills.
3. To provide value-based education that promotes ethics and social responsibility and enables students to contribute positively to society and the nation.
Core Values
D.H.S.K Commrece College upholds the values of respect, equality, honesty, transparency and ethical conduct in academic and administrative functions. To practice these
            values, the college constantly endeavours to create an inclusive learning environment, ensure fairness and accountability in all process, promote integrity in teaching
            and evaluation, and encourage responsible participation from all its stakeholders- students, staff and guardians.

The National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) is a flagship program under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. The Ministry of Education, GoI
            has entrusted "Board of Practical Training, Eastern Region", BOPT(ER) with the responsibility of implementing apprenticeship training for general stream
            graduates which comes under the purview of The Apprentices (Amendment) Act 2014. It is expected that the graduates in general streams (such as B.A., B.Sc.,
            B.Com.) will also be able to bridge the gap between educational qualification and practical (hands-on) experience and the candidates will be highly
            benefitted in acquiring better career opportunities similar to Engineering Graduates.
